title: The Pair of Dry Socks
youtube_title: The Pair of Dry Socks | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing a little can make two people feel expected.
summary: At a courtyard supper with a long table and a fig tree, Niko sees that a pair of dry socks when someone else's were soaked will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Niko makes a smaller, even share so Anil is included, and Grandpa Sol lets the choice stand without a speech.
